Test Case Description: Verify successful password change with correct current password and matching confirmation
PreRequisites:
- User is logged in (staff01)
- Current password: Password123!
- User knows their current password
Step Expected Result: Change password form is displayed with three fields: Current Password, New Password, Confirm New Password
Test Case Expected Result: Password is successfully changed. All existing refresh tokens are revoked, user is logged out from all devices except current session.

Step Expected Result: Password is masked, matches new password

- Success message: 'Đổi mật khẩu thành công. Bạn sẽ cần đăng nhập lại trên các thiết bị khác'
- MatKhauHash is updated in NGUOIDUNG table with BCrypt hash of new password
- All refresh tokens are deleted from REFRESH_TOKENS table (force logout on all other devices)
- Current session remains active
- User can login with new password
